title: Concept: Disbursement account exposed on a loan
description: A disbursement account field on a loan record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The disbursement account is where the bank credits a sanctioned amount, so changing it is a direct path to diverting a payout, and exposing it in a response hands over the target.
applicability: Deployments that render a disbursement account field on a loan record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The disbursement account is where the bank credits a sanctioned amount, so changing it is a direct path to diverting a payout, and exposing it in a response hands over the target.
